blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—The city council raised questions about the handling of an Aug. 26 operation involving employees of a lending company called 1 Loyalty. It is particularly inquiring about the decision to transfer to Manila of 24 arrested persons. The council is also wondering why there was lack of information provided to the local National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) office afterwards. The matter was discussed during the council’s regular session on Nov. 9. The talks came following concerns about the involvement of the NBI Homicide Division in the operation and the subsequent handling of those who were nabbed.
